Probe, and the scan is REAL: the modal opens when CommentLayer's own
orphan scan finds a pinned comment whose element has left the canvas DOM.
The probe supplies the three inputs that scan reads — a canvas root with
two rendered elements, an active page, and two open comments anchored to
ids that are not among them — and lets the shipped detector decide. It
also replays `ELEMENT_DELETED` so the modal can quote what each pin was
on; that label is captured client-side from the live instance and is never
stored, so nothing else can produce it.
